title: 10 — VALIDATION GATES (consolidated catalog)
summary: Consolidated catalog of all project validation gates grouped into nine gate classes, with triggers, runners, evidence artifacts, and failure protocols.
notes: Not in an adr/prd/spec directory, but content is a normative contract catalog: numbered gate IDs (SIM-070..075, MD-070..074, AD-040..044, BP-G-xx), thresholds (R-hat < 1.01, cov >= 80%, tol 1e-6), runners and failure protocols. These are enforceable technical constraints -> SPEC over DOC. References ADRs for exceptions but contains no Decision/Consequences structure of its own.
